target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Val Verde — Amistad National Recreation Area inventory vouchers Rhus microphylla in canyons/uplands. Hays/Purola lists R. microphylla only among introduced plants, so Hays is explicitly excluded. Three exact target-zone native counties are not yet locked.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need two additional exact target-zone native counties.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not count the introduced Hays planting as native range evidence.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the tiny compound leaves. Littleleaf sumac is a thornless, densely branched shrub with odd-pinnate leaves made of several very small dull green leaflets, often on a slightly winged rachis; whitish flowers appear before or with the leaves and red fruits cluster later.
diagnostic_traits: odd-pinnate leaves with several very small leaflets
leaflets dull green and often hairy

comparisons.key_distinctions: Unlike R. aromatica, leaves are not just three large fan-shaped leaflets; they are multi-foliolate with much smaller leaflets. Unlike thorny colima-type shrubs, R. microphylla lacks spines.
